about: The cabbage seed packet (Items/Seeds/CabbageSeeds.et): a small printed paper envelope, 9 x 14 cm, with a painted savoy cabbage on a cream ground, CABBAGE / SEEDS lettering, a green band and a folded, glued flap on the back with planting notes. US English, no brand, no place name. Built by build.py in headless Blender (kitlib) with a procedural print atlas; replaces the vanilla Papers_Personal folded papers stand-in. Meshy is reserved for fish and masks.

layout_m.about: Enfusion metres. The packet stands in the x-y plane, front toward +z, origin at its centre: the prefab rests it with RestingUP Forward, so the front faces up on the ground.
